chain_words.nuance: sufficient for a purpose, though not especially impressive
reliable and well made, with no major faults
a general high standard of quality or performance
exceptionally good, often in a way that impresses others
so far above the standard that it stands out among everything else

explanation: These words all describe quality, moving from something sufficient to something so far above the norm that it stands out.

usage_notes.difference: 'Excellent' describes a high standard in general; 'superb' suggests quality that is impressive and often admired by others.
